svg.title: Jukebox — record player robot
svg.desc: A cherry robot built as an arched jukebox, with two round eyes in a band under the arch, yellow and cyan light tubes around a window showing a record, a row of selector buttons, a speaker grille, short ring jointed arms with pincers and short legs on round feet.
